title: Manager Updates
description: Panduan status ringkas, callout risiko, dan permintaan keputusan ke manager.

items.scenario: Your manager asks for a weekly status on the reliability roadmap. Two initiatives are on track; one is blocked on security review.
items.scenarioId: Manager Anda meminta weekly status tentang roadmap reliability. Dua inisiatif on track; satu terblokir di security review.
items.prompt: What is the strongest opening status line?
items.promptId: Apa baris status pembuka yang paling kuat?

choices.text: Busy week, lots of meetings.
choices.textId: Minggu sibuk, banyak meeting.

choices.text: Two of three reliability initiatives are on track. The SLO dashboard work is blocked on security review; I need your help unblocking by Friday or we slip the release by one sprint.
choices.textId: Dua dari tiga inisiatif reliability on track. Pekerjaan SLO dashboard terblokir di security review; saya butuh bantuan Anda unblock sebelum Jumat atau release mundur satu sprint.

choices.text: Everything is fine unless something changes.
choices.textId: Semuanya baik kecuali ada yang berubah.

choices.text: I will send a long document later.
choices.textId: Saya akan kirim dokumen panjang nanti.

items.explanation: Manager butuh progress, blocker, dan ask yang jelas beserta dampak deadline. Frasa: "on track" = sesuai jadwal; "blocked on…" = terhambat oleh…; "I need your help unblocking" = minta bantuan membuka blokir; "or we slip…" = atau jadwal mundur. A/C kosong; D menunda kejelasan.

items.scenario: You discovered a capacity risk: current traffic growth will exhaust DB CPU in about six weeks if unchanged.
items.scenarioId: Anda menemukan risiko kapasitas: pertumbuhan traffic saat ini akan menghabiskan DB CPU dalam sekitar enam minggu jika tidak diubah.
items.prompt: How do you escalate the risk?

choices.text: The database might get slow someday.
choices.textId: Database mungkin lambat suatu hari.

choices.text: Risk: at current growth, DB CPU hits saturation in ~6 weeks. Impact: elevated latency and possible checkout errors. Options: (1) scale vertically this month, (2) accelerate read-replica work. I recommend option 1 as a bridge; need budget approval by next Tuesday.
choices.textId: Risiko: pada pertumbuhan saat ini, DB CPU jenuh dalam ~6 minggu. Dampak: latency naik dan kemungkinan error checkout. Opsi: (1) scale vertikal bulan ini, (2) percepat pekerjaan read-replica. Saya rekomendasikan opsi 1 sebagai jembatan; butuh approval budget sebelum Selasa depan.

choices.text: We should panic and rewrite the database layer.
choices.textId: Kita harus panik dan rewrite layer database.

choices.text: I already ordered hardware without asking.
choices.textId: Saya sudah pesan hardware tanpa bertanya.

items.explanation: Update risiko harus mencakup timeline, dampak, opsi, rekomendasi, dan tanggal keputusan. Hafalkan pola: Risk → Impact → Options → I recommend → need decision by. A samar; C panik; D melampaui wewenang.

items.scenario: You will miss a committed date because a dependency team delayed their API.
items.scenarioId: Anda akan miss tanggal yang sudah di-commit karena tim dependency menunda API mereka.
items.prompt: What should you tell your manager?
items.promptId: Apa yang harus Anda sampaikan ke manager?

choices.text: It is not my fault.
choices.textId: Ini bukan salah saya.

choices.text: We will miss Thursday's date because Payments API delivery slipped to next Monday. New ETA is next Wednesday. I have a workaround spike in progress and will confirm feasibility by tomorrow noon.
choices.textId: Kami akan miss tanggal Kamis karena delivery Payments API mundur ke Senin depan. ETA baru Rabu depan. Saya sedang kerjakan spike workaround dan akan konfirmasi kelayakan besok siang.

choices.text: Maybe we can still make it somehow.
choices.textId: Mungkin kita masih bisa mengejar entah bagaimana.

choices.text: I did not want to bother you with this.
choices.textId: Saya tidak ingin mengganggu Anda dengan ini.

items.explanation: Sampaikan kabar buruk lebih awal, dengan penyebab, ETA baru, dan mitigasi — tanpa drama menyalahkan. Frasa: "will miss… because…" = akan telat karena…; "new ETA" = estimasi baru; "workaround spike" = eksplorasi solusi sementara. A defensif; C tidak jelas; D menyembunyikan risiko.

items.scenario: Your manager asks whether the team can take on an urgent partner integration this quarter.
items.scenarioId: Manager bertanya apakah tim bisa mengambil integrasi partner mendesak kuartal ini.
items.prompt: What is a clear capacity response?

choices.text: Sure, we can do everything.
choices.textId: Tentu, kita bisa kerjakan semuanya.

choices.text: We can take it if we pause the observability upgrade or add one contractor. Without that tradeoff, quality risk is high. Which priority should we protect?
choices.textId: Kita bisa ambil jika kita pause upgrade observability atau tambah satu contractor. Tanpa tradeoff itu, risiko kualitas tinggi. Prioritas mana yang harus kita jaga?

choices.text: No. Never.
choices.textId: Tidak. Tidak pernah.

choices.text: Let me think and never follow up.
choices.textId: Biar saya pikirkan dan tidak pernah follow up.

items.explanation: Jawaban kapasitas yang baik menawarkan tradeoff dan meminta keputusan prioritas. Frasa: "we can take it if…" = bisa jika…; "without that tradeoff" = tanpa pertukaran itu; "which priority should we protect?" = prioritas mana yang dijaga. A overcommit; C menutup opsi; D menghindar.

items.scenario: You need approval to buy a monitoring tool that costs $18k/year. ROI is reduced MTTR and fewer pages for the on-call team.
items.scenarioId: Anda butuh approval membeli tool monitoring seharga $18k/tahun. ROI-nya MTTR turun dan page on-call lebih sedikit.

choices.text: Please approve this tool because other companies use it.
choices.textId: Tolong approve tool ini karena perusahaan lain juga memakainya.

choices.text: Requesting approval for $18k/year monitoring. Expected outcome: cut median MTTR by ~25% and reduce noisy pages. Pilot for 30 days with success metrics attached. Can we decide this week?
choices.textId: Meminta approval monitoring $18k/tahun. Hasil yang diharapkan: potong median MTTR ~25% dan kurangi page berisik. Pilot 30 hari dengan success metrics terlampir. Bisakah kita putuskan minggu ini?

choices.text: I already signed up for the annual plan.
choices.textId: Saya sudah mendaftar paket tahunan.

choices.text: If we do not buy this, the team will quit.
choices.textId: Jika tidak membeli ini, tim akan resign.

items.explanation: Ask budget butuh biaya, outcome yang diharapkan, cara mengukur, dan timeline keputusan. Frasa: "expected outcome" = hasil yang diharapkan; "pilot for 30 days" = uji coba 30 hari; "can we decide this week?" = minta keputusan minggu ini. A bandwagon; C melampaui wewenang; D ancaman emosional.

items.scenario: After a SEV-1, your manager wants a same-day summary for the VP.
items.scenarioId: Setelah SEV-1, manager Anda ingin ringkasan hari yang sama untuk VP.
items.promptId: Ringkasan mana yang siap untuk eksekutif?

choices.text: We had a bad day with Kubernetes and Redis and DNS and deploys.
choices.textId: Kami punya hari buruk dengan Kubernetes dan Redis dan DNS dan deploy.

choices.text: Summary for VP: 47 minutes of checkout degradation. Root cause: bad feature flag default. Mitigated by disabling flag. Customer impact: ~9% failed checkouts. Follow-ups: flag defaults review and canary checks — owners assigned, due Friday.
choices.textId: Ringkasan untuk VP: 47 menit degradasi checkout. Root cause: default feature flag buruk. Dimitigasi dengan menonaktifkan flag. Dampak pelanggan: ~9% checkout gagal. Follow-up: review default flag dan canary checks — owner sudah ditunjuk, jatuh tempo Jumat.

choices.text: Please read the raw Slack thread.
choices.textId: Tolong baca thread Slack mentah.

choices.text: Someone made a mistake; details TBD.
choices.textId: Seseorang membuat kesalahan; detail TBD.

items.explanation: Ringkasan eksekutif: durasi, dampak, penyebab di ketinggian yang tepat, mitigasi, dan follow-up bertanggal. Pola: duration → root cause → mitigated by → customer impact → follow-ups with owners/due. A terlalu teknis acak; C melempar pekerjaan; D menyalahkan tanpa detail.

items.scenario: Your 1:1 is starting. You want to discuss feeling overloaded by interrupt-driven work.
items.scenarioId: 1:1 Anda dimulai. Anda ingin membahas perasaan overload karena pekerjaan interrupt-driven.
items.prompt: How do you raise it productively?

choices.text: I am drowning and this job is impossible.
choices.textId: Saya tenggelam dan pekerjaan ini mustahil.

choices.text: I want to discuss interrupt load. This week I spent about 60% of time on ad-hoc requests, which delayed the auth migration. Can we define an intake path and protect two focus blocks daily?
choices.textId: Saya ingin bahas beban interrupt. Minggu ini sekitar 60% waktu untuk request ad-hoc, yang menunda auth migration. Bisakah kita definisikan jalur intake dan jaga dua focus block setiap hari?

choices.text: I will just work nights to catch up.
choices.textId: Saya akan kerja malam saja untuk mengejar.

choices.text: Everyone else has it easier than I do.
choices.textId: Semua orang lain lebih mudah daripada saya.

items.explanation: Gunakan data, dampak ke komitmen, dan ask proses yang konkret. Frasa: "I want to discuss…" = pembuka netral; "which delayed…" = dampak; "can we define… and protect…" = minta solusi proses. A emosional tanpa ask; C burnout; D membandingkan.

items.scenario: A project is green on delivery but red on quality (flaky tests rising). Your manager only asked about dates.
items.scenarioId: Proyek hijau di delivery tapi merah di kualitas (flaky tests naik). Manager hanya menanya tanggal.

choices.text: Dates are fine, nothing else matters.
choices.textId: Tanggal aman, yang lain tidak penting.

choices.text: Delivery date is still green, but quality risk is rising: flaky tests up 30% this month. I propose a two-day stabilization window before the release; otherwise we accept higher rollback risk.
choices.textId: Tanggal delivery masih hijau, tapi risiko kualitas naik: flaky tests naik 30% bulan ini. Saya usulkan jendela stabilisasi dua hari sebelum release; jika tidak, kita menerima risiko rollback lebih tinggi.

choices.text: QA will somehow handle it.
choices.textId: QA entah bagaimana akan menanganinya.

choices.text: I prefer not to mention problems.
choices.textId: Saya lebih suka tidak menyebut masalah.

items.explanation: Munculkan risiko tersembunyi beserta tradeoff yang direkomendasikan meski tidak ditanya. Frasa: "still green, but…" = masih baik, tapi…; "I propose…; otherwise…" = usulan + konsekuensi alternatif. A/D menyembunyikan risiko; C melempar tanggung jawab.

items.scenario: You disagree with a leadership directive to skip canaries for a hot fix.
items.scenarioId: Anda tidak setuju dengan arahan leadership untuk skip canary pada hot fix.

choices.text: That is reckless and I will not do it.
choices.textId: Itu sembrono dan saya tidak akan melakukannya.

choices.text: I understand the urgency. Skipping canaries increases blast radius. I recommend a 5-minute canary on 5% traffic with auto-rollback. If we must go faster, please confirm we accept the elevated risk.
choices.textId: Saya paham urgensi. Skip canary memperbesar blast radius. Saya rekomendasikan canary 5 menit di 5% traffic dengan auto-rollback. Jika harus lebih cepat, tolong konfirmasi kita menerima risiko yang lebih tinggi.

choices.text: Whatever you say.
choices.textId: Terserah Anda.

choices.text: I will complain in a side channel after the meeting.
choices.textId: Saya akan mengeluh di side channel setelah meeting.

items.explanation: Disagree dengan mengakui tujuan, menyatakan risiko, menawarkan alternatif lebih aman, dan memperjelas ownership keputusan. Frasa: "I understand the urgency" = akui tujuan; "blast radius" = luas dampak; "please confirm we accept…" = minta keputusan sadar risiko. A menolak kasar; C pasrah; D tidak transparan.

items.scenario: End of day. Your manager is offline. You need to leave an async update about a production change.
items.scenarioId: Akhir hari. Manager offline. Anda perlu meninggalkan update async tentang perubahan production.

choices.text: Did a thing in prod.
choices.textId: Sudah melakukan sesuatu di prod.

choices.text: Shipped rate-limit change to production at 17:40 local. Expected: fewer abuse spikes. Watch: 429 rate and checkout success. Rollback command documented in the change ticket. Ping me if 429s exceed 2% for 10 minutes.
choices.textId: Sudah ship perubahan rate-limit ke production pukul 17:40 lokal. Diharapkan: abuse spike berkurang. Pantau: rate 429 dan keberhasilan checkout. Perintah rollback ada di change ticket. Ping saya jika 429 melebihi 2% selama 10 menit.

choices.text: Please review all dashboards when you are back.
choices.textId: Tolong review semua dashboard saat Anda kembali.

choices.text: No update; talk tomorrow.
choices.textId: Tidak ada update; bicara besok.

items.explanation: Update async perlu apa yang berubah, efek yang diharapkan, apa yang dipantau, dan isyarat rollback. Pola: Shipped X at T → Expected → Watch → Rollback → Ping if…. A/C/D kurang actionable.

items.scenario: Your manager asks for a 'quick gut feel' on a risky launch.
items.scenarioId: Manager meminta 'quick gut feel' tentang launch yang berisiko.

choices.text: I guess it is fine.
choices.textId: Kurasa baik-baik saja.

choices.text: Gut feel is cautious. Confidence is medium: canary looks good, but we lack load-test coverage for peak. Recommendation: delay 48 hours for a targeted test, or launch with a rapid rollback owner on bridge.
choices.textId: Gut feel hati-hati. Confidence medium: canary terlihat baik, tapi kita kurang coverage load-test untuk peak. Rekomendasi: tunda 48 jam untuk tes terarah, atau launch dengan owner rollback cepat di bridge.

choices.text: Refuse to give any opinion.
choices.textId: Menolak memberi opini apa pun.

choices.text: Guarantee zero risk forever.
choices.textId: Menjamin risiko nol selamanya.

items.explanation: Ubah gut feel menjadi confidence, gap, dan opsi. Frasa: "confidence is medium" = tingkat keyakinan sedang; "we lack…" = celah; "recommendation: A, or B" = dua jalur keputusan. A samar; C tidak membantu; D tidak realistis.

items.scenario: Headcount was cut mid-quarter. Your manager asks what to de-scope.
items.scenarioId: Headcount dipotong di tengah kuartal. Manager bertanya apa yang harus di-de-scope.

choices.text: We will still do everything with heroes.
choices.textId: Kami tetap kerjakan semuanya dengan heroics.

choices.text: With one fewer engineer, I recommend pausing the nice-to-have reporting UI and protecting checkout reliability and the partner API. I will send a revised roadmap with customer impact notes today.
choices.textId: Dengan satu engineer lebih sedikit, saya rekomendasikan pause reporting UI nice-to-have dan jaga reliability checkout serta partner API. Saya akan kirim roadmap revisi dengan catatan dampak pelanggan hari ini.

choices.text: Cut on-call coverage first.
choices.textId: Potong coverage on-call dulu.

choices.text: Hide the constraint from stakeholders.
choices.textId: Sembunyikan batasan dari stakeholder.

items.explanation: Buat tradeoff eksplisit yang terikat pada dampak pelanggan. Frasa: "with one fewer… I recommend pausing X and protecting Y" = dengan kapasitas turun, pause X jaga Y; "revised roadmap… today" = komitmen artefak segera. A heroics; C memotong yang kritis; D tidak transparan.

items.scenario: You need your manager to unblock access to a production dashboard.
items.scenarioId: Anda butuh manager membuka akses ke dashboard production.

choices.text: Access please.
choices.textId: Akses dong.

choices.text: I need read access to the checkout Grafana folder to finish the weekly reliability report by Thursday. Could you approve the access request ticket LINK today?
choices.textId: Saya butuh read access ke folder Grafana checkout untuk menyelesaikan laporan reliability mingguan sebelum Kamis. Bisakah Anda approve tiket permintaan akses LINK hari ini?

choices.text: Try random credentials.
choices.textId: Coba kredensial acak.

choices.text: Ask every week forever without a ticket.
choices.textId: Minta setiap minggu selamanya tanpa tiket.

items.explanation: Ask mencakup why, deadline, dan artefak aksi. Frasa: "I need X to finish Y by Z" = butuh X untuk Y sebelum Z; "could you approve… today?" = minta aksi spesifik hari ini. A terlalu pendek; C tidak aman; D tidak efisien.

items.scenario: A peer team is taking credit for your reliability win in a leadership channel.
items.scenarioId: Tim peer mengklaim kredit atas kemenangan reliability Anda di channel leadership.

choices.text: Call them liars publicly.
choices.textId: Sebut mereka pembohong secara publik.

choices.text: Glad the outcome helped customers. For accuracy: detection work and rollback were led by our team with Platform support on dashboards. Happy to co-write a short shared summary if useful.
choices.textId: Senang hasilnya membantu pelanggan. Demi akurasi: pekerjaan deteksi dan rollback dipimpin tim kami dengan dukungan Platform di dashboard. Siap co-write ringkasan bersama singkat jika berguna.

choices.text: Stay silent forever.
choices.textId: Diam selamanya.

choices.text: Start a flame war.
choices.textId: Mulai perang komentar.

items.explanation: Koreksi catatan dengan tenang dan undang narasi bersama. Frasa: "glad the outcome…" = mulai positif; "for accuracy…" = koreksi fakta; "happy to co-write…" = tawarkan kolaborasi. A/D agresif; C membiarkan kesalahan.

items.scenario: Quarterly business review: you have 90 seconds for reliability.
items.scenarioId: Quarterly business review: Anda punya 90 detik untuk reliability.

choices.text: We clicked many buttons and looked at graphs.
choices.textId: Kami banyak klik tombol dan melihat grafik.

choices.text: Reliability: checkout availability 99.95% vs 99.9% target; two SEV-2s, both mitigated under 30 minutes; top risk is DB CPU growth — decision needed on scale-up budget this month.
choices.textId: Reliability: ketersediaan checkout 99.95% vs target 99.9%; dua SEV-2, keduanya dimitigasi di bawah 30 menit; risiko utama pertumbuhan DB CPU — keputusan budget scale-up dibutuhkan bulan ini.

choices.text: Read a 20-page appendix aloud.
choices.textId: Bacakan appendix 20 halaman dengan keras.

choices.text: Say no risks exist.
choices.textId: Katakan tidak ada risiko.

items.explanation: Metrik vs target, insiden, risiko utama, ask keputusan — semua dalam satu napas. Pola QBR: metric vs target → incidents → top risk → decision needed. A tidak bermakna; C terlalu panjang; D menutup risiko.
